purpose: Read-only inventory of missing/partial/invalid legacy four-hour symbol-session rows and exact-key daily OHLCV availability. This audit does not make legacy bars eligible as scoring features.

data_source_policy.legacy_four_hour: User-provided local CSV export or copy of existing values; read only; never write back.
data_source_policy.daily: Already-cached local daily OHLCV; no new retrieval.
data_source_policy.calendar: Frozen local official XTKS session calendar.
data_source_policy.runtime: Standard local Python only; no Codex runtime dependency, APIs, paid services, or external notification.

key: Normalized symbol plus official XTKS session date.

timestamp_policy.offset_aware_timestamp: Convert to Asia/Tokyo before deriving date and slot.

four_hour_classification.COMPLETE_EXPECTED_SLOTS: Exactly one valid 09:00 and one valid 13:00 row and no other slot.
four_hour_classification.NO_4H_BARS: Daily symbol/session exists but no corresponding intraday rows exist.
four_hour_classification.DUPLICATE_OR_UNEXPECTED_4H_BARS: Duplicate expected slots or timestamps outside expected slots.
four_hour_classification.INVALID_4H_OHLCV: At least one present intraday row has invalid OHLCV.

population: All daily symbol/session pairs in the audited date span plus observed four-hour-only keys. A pair absent from both inputs needs a point-in-time security universe and cannot be inferred.

price_semantics.daily_ohlcv: Included to prove same-key availability only.
price_semantics.adjustment_consistency: NOT_ASSESSED_BY_COVERAGE_AUDIT; source metadata must be checked separately.
price_semantics.permitted_use: Coverage diagnostics only; no daily-to-intraday synthesis and no model feature promotion.

outputs: summary.json with input SHA-256 values, counts, and scope limitations
prohibited: Modifying the source sheet or source export
Fetching data or using production credentials
Filling, forward-filling, or synthesizing intraday OHLC from daily bars
Claiming pairs absent from both sources were audited
Using this legacy coverage audit to qualify a scoring model
